result_summary.title: Payment Gateway v2 Double Charges and Overcharging in Staging
result_summary.description: We are seeing overcharges and subscriptions being charged twice in the Payment Gateway v2 staging environment (EU-West). This is impacting 751 test users. We are sure this is due to incorrect load balancer routing, causing duplicate requests to hit the billing processor. Please adjust the routing configuration to ensure requests are only processed once.
